Mahadev App Kingpin Extradited from Oman to India

Saurabh Chandrakar, described as the kingpin of the Mahadev app betting operation, has been extradited from Oman to India. The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) is expected to investigate the betting network. The extradition raises questions about future actions in the case.
